title: Return to Wonderland with Innospec
summary: Innospec invites you to Return to Wonderland with its 2026 Personal Care campaign, reimagining the world of Alice in Wonderland through innovative formulations and modern consumer insights. Each character reflects a different personal care mindset, brought to life with Innospec ingredients and inspired product concepts

extraction.key_fact: 이노스펙이 이상한 나라의 앨리스를 현대적 제형과 소비자 통찰로 재해석한 퍼스널 케어 캠페인을 선보였다.
